title: Men Pitching Horseshoes by Shed, c. 1950 B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: This lot where the men pitch horseshoes - is right outside my kitchen windows.
description: A casual black-and-white snapshot captured looking out toward an open sandy lot where a group of men has gathered to play horseshoes. Flanked by palm trees, parked mid-century automobiles, and a small wooden shelter shed, the setting conveys warm-weather neighborhood camaraderie and everyday postwar leisure right outside the photographer's kitchen window.
